blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Chinese Embassy in Manila on Thursday rejected the Department of Foreign Affairs’ (DFA) criticism of its social media remarks, which the Philippine agency described as having an “escalatory and undiplomatic tone and language.” The DFA said the embassy’s statements “erode mutual trust and confidence and severely undermine the efforts to stabilize and improve bilateral relations.” READ: DFA warns Chinese Embassy of further action over online attacks Hours later, the Chinese Embassy pushed back against the DFA’s admonition. “The Embassy doesn’t accept the DFA’s public statements in relation to the Embassy’s pushing back against attacks and smears on […]...
